dossier_meta.statement_text: What is the smallest constant $\alpha$ such that every $Z_3$-flow-critical graph $G$ satisfies $|E(G)| \leq \frac{5}{2}|V(G)| + \alpha g(G) + O(1)$?
dossier_meta.context_text: Theorem 1.5 establishes $\alpha \leq 5/2$, while the example of $K^+_{3,n-3}$ (which has Euler genus $\lceil\frac{n-5}{2}\rceil$) shows $\alpha \geq 1$, giving $1 \leq \alpha \leq 5/2$. The authors remark that the dependence on genus in Theorem 1.5 is likely not optimal.
